segments.name: Soybean Processing and Refining
segments.description: Crushes soybeans and refines the oil and meal for food, feed and fuel customers.
segments.evidence: Operating Segments We conduct our operations through four reportable segments: Soybean Processing and Refining, Softseed Processing and Refining, Other Oilseeds Processing and Refining, and Grain Merchandising and Milling, which are organized based upon their similar economic characteristics, products and services offered, production processes, types and classes of customer, and distribution methods.
